system.creatureSubtype: immune to Frightened, Charmed; Fortune on saves vs magic; does not need air, food, drink, or sleep
system.tactics: Star Spawn Hulks advance and hit things. They lack tactical judgment but execute instructions with perfect obedience, which makes them reliable in a way that smarter Aberrations often are not. Reality Shockwave is used instinctively when multiple enemies cluster within range — the Hulk does not distinguish ally from enemy in that zone, which the summoner should communicate clearly before the encounter begins.
system.attacksNotes:
Slam [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 4 + Melee Combat 6), Reach: 15 ft

  • Margin 1:: 18 damage (10 + 8 Str).
  • Margin 2: 18 damage, DR halved (round up); target makes Fortitude [Easy] save or Stunned until end of their next turn.
  • Margin 3: 18 damage, DR halved (round up); Stunned, no save.

Reality Shockwave (Recharge 5-8) [Combat]: All creatures within 30 feet make Will saves. Compare Hulk's Str 8 against each target's save.

  • Margin 1:: 20 psychic damage + Disoriented,
  • Margin 2: 20 psychic damage, DR halved (round up) + Dazed + Disoriented. Psychic damage ignores DR.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Psychic Mirror: When the Star Spawn Hulk is hit by a weave that deals psychic damage or imposes a mind-affecting condition, the attacker makes a Will [Easy] save or is also affected by the same condition. This is reflexive and not a choice. Powerful Build: Counts as Gigantic for carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting. Alien Mind: The Hulk is immune to Charmed and to all mind-reading or telepathy effects. It cannot be communicated with through telepathy. A summoner's instructions are received as direct behavioral commands. Resilient Defense (2/day): When the Star Spawn Hulk Fiend fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
